source_claim: SEGA's official PSO2 character sources identify Clariskrays and Tiea within Phantasy Star Online 2, the official PSO2 anime site identifies Washinomiya Koori in its PSO2-based production, and SEGA's official Phantasy Star Portable 2 character page identifies Emilia Percival in that specific game.
notes: SEGA's official PSO2 character introduction page names クラリスクレイス in its roster for Phantasy Star Online 2 (https://pso2.jp/players/about/character/; the official Ep Oracle character profile also describes her role: https://pso2.jp/anime_eporacle/character/21/). The same official PSO2 anime source gives a profile for ティア (https://pso2.jp/anime_eporacle/character/11/), identifying her as one of the PSO2 story characters. SEGA's official PSO2 15th anniversary TV anime site gives a profile for コオリ and labels the production as based on PHANTASY STAR ONLINE 2 (https://phantasystar.sega.jp/psportal/pso15anniversary/animation/character/31/; original game credit: https://phantasystar.sega.jp/psportal/pso15anniversary/animation/caststaff/). SEGA's official Phantasy Star Portable 2 character page profiles エミリア・パーシバル in that title (https://phantasystar.sega.jp/psp2/world/character/). The four relations retain the specific game copyright established by the respective official source. Other campaign members are not assigned here: the checked official records identify several as costumes, generic class archetypes, or a recurring mascot, and the remaining exact identity-to-work mapping was not established by these sources.
